# BDO Serialization Test Vectors

Generated by `generate.mjs` — see README.md for scope and rules. FROZEN: a
regeneration that changes any byte signals a breaking profile change.

## collectible-minimal

Smallest conforming collectible: required slots only; content is the media (A5).

```json
{
  "type": "collectible",
  "identity": {
    "scheme": "taproot-assets-genesis"
  },
  "integrity": {
    "scheme": "carrier-commitment"
  },
  "content": {
    "media": [
      {
        "uri": "https://example.com/art.png"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

## ticket-full

Ticket with metadata, validity window, uses, an attribute, and an integrity ref binding the image bytes. The metadata.name is written in the source with a DECOMPOSED accent (Cafe\u0301) and must serialize NFC-composed.

```json
{
  "type": "ticket",
  "identity": {
    "scheme": "taproot-assets-genesis"
  },
  "integrity": {
    "scheme": "carrier-commitment",
    "refs": [
      {
        "subject": "metadata.image",
        "alg": "sha-256",
        "digest": "00fc2e83cef378960e1c228055845c2825ba9148337bb9c0adf9710a288e7dc1"
      }
    ]
  },
  "content": {
    "event": "Satoshi Stadium Final",
    "ticket_type": "General",
    "valid_from": 1767225600,
    "valid_until": 1767312000,
    "uses": 1
  },
  "metadata": {
    "name": "Entrada Café Final",
    "issuer": "Vector Issuer",
    "image": "https://example.com/ticket.png",
    "attributes": [
      {
        "trait": "row",
        "value": "10"
      }
    ]
  }
}
```

```

```

## collectible-with-extension

Collectible carrying one Extension item (urn:stas:ext:bdo-attestation). The payload here is EXEMPLARY opaque bytes — the attestation payload serialization is defined by the Extension and is byte-preserved by this layer regardless of its content.

```json
{
  "type": "collectible",
  "identity": {
    "scheme": "taproot-assets-genesis"
  },
  "integrity": {
    "scheme": "carrier-commitment"
  },
  "content": {
    "media": [
      {
        "uri": "https://example.com/art.png"
      }
    ]
  },
  "extensions": [
    {
      "id": "bdo-attestation",
      "ns": "urn:stas:ext",
      "ver": "0.1.0",
      "req": "MAY_IGNORE",
      "payload": "7b226578616d706c65223a226f7061717565206174746573746174696f6e207061796c6f6164227d"
    }
  ]
}
```

```

```

Meta Commitment (SHA-256 of the bytes above):

```
9e162a8f7ca007b3955c756e6e213f4a9637171513a50cb3c045f0895dc0915f
```
